QuestInfo.name: [Home] Jeffrey's Housewarming Party
QuestInfo.0: You received an invitation to Jeffrey's housewarming party. It seems his long dream of building a home in Querencia is coming to fruition.
QuestInfo.1: During the housewarming, Trudy caught Jeffrey's tail! But Kenneth and the residents said they had known his identity from the beginning. Jeffrey took off his uncomfortable disguise, and people accepted his true form without hesitation. We hope Jeffrey will continue to have good days in the future also.
